mechanics.claim: LeBlanc's next damaging ability against the marked target consumes the mark to deal a second, separate instance of magic damage equal to the initial hit.
mechanics.quote: '''LeBlanc's''' next damaging {{tip|champion ability|ability}} against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the {{ccs|same {{as|magic damage}}|magic}} again.

mechanics.claim: The mark expires after 3.5 seconds if not consumed by a follow-up damaging ability.
Sigil of Malice and Mimic: Sigil of Malice can detonate each other's marks.
mechanics.quote: ''Sigil of Malice'' and {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} can detonate each other's marks.

mechanics.claim: Killing the target with the orb or the mark's consumption refunds mana and cooldown; this only applies on a kill, not against a stationary dummy that never dies mid-fight in the usual sense but would trigger if it is reduced below 0.
